# bcp

> bcp (Browser Control Profiles) drives several Chromium profiles at once with Browser Control: one extension copy,
> relay port and MCP server per profile, so each AI agent gets its own logged in profile. No dependencies, Node 22+.

Install: `npm install -g github:jpsanders/bcp#1.1.0`. Set up: `bcp init`, `bcp sync`, load each copy unpacked, then
`bcp check`. Give agents their servers with `bcp mcp --all --json`.
